newsitem.title: PERU: Peru's Edegel sets dividend from profits.
newsitem.headline: Peru's Edegel sets dividend from profits.

text.p: Peruvian electricity generator Edegel has set a cash dividend of 0.02865 soles per share totalling 63.8 million soles ($24.3 million) from its 1996 profits, the Lima Stock Exchange said Monday.
The exchange said the record date for the dividend was April 10 and the payout date April 24.
In October 1995, the government sold a 60 percent stake in Edegel to the foreign-led Generandes consortium for $524.45 million.
Generandes includes U.S.-based Entergy Corp's EP Edegel Inc unit, Chile's Empresa Nacional de Electricidad SA Chile (Endesa), and local firms Grana y Montero and Banco Wiese Ltdo.
Edegel, which generates power for the Lima area, is comprised of five hydroelectric centrals and a thermal plant with a capacity to produce 700 megawatts (MW).
